notes.title: Updata to 0.2.33.0
【Wars of Seignior】 Game will publish and change to Free to play
notes.notes:
After a long-term Early Access, the "Wars of Seignior" will be change to the official release version. Then the game will become Free to play.
Old players who pay for the purchase can contact us. We will give Compensation, thank you for your support!
contact us: @WeMakeApp Studio 
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: [EA Update 06]《Wars of Seignior》Ver:0.2.28.0 New card and Lucky pool is coming (20181113)
notes.notes:
Hello my lords ， we will update a new version 

1. Card added: 15 new cards added

1). Archwizard (attack / blood: 2/25)
Skill: Exchange the crystal skills of both sides, and give the enemy all units a random DEBUFF when playing.
2). Elfling (attack / blood: 0/8)
Skill: Fly to the ancestors to get their attack.
3). Spider King (attack / blood: 1/24)
Skill: Use the spider silk to pull yourself to the enemy crystal side, and the person attacking him will be temporarily bound by the spider silk.
4). Angel of Flight Alabaster (attack / blood: 2/30)
Skills: General attack can kill enemies with less than 2 attacks.
5). Claw of Terror (attack / blood: 3/20)
Skills: puncture attack; blood teeth: 50% of the damage is converted into your own blood; dead words: summon 3 bats
6). Onihime(attack / blood: 3/30)
Skills: You can collect souls from the battlefield to increase your blood.
7). Onimusha (attack / blood: 4/30
Skills: You can detonate the collected souls on the field to cause damage.
8). Spear Shooter (attack/blood: 1/15)
Skill: The attack is far away and there is a probability to trigger a crit.
9). Templar Fallen One (attack / blood: 2/20)
Skills: When the Holy Shield is destroyed, you gain your own bonus.
10).Cyclops (attack/blood: 2/30)
Skills: One-eyed launch rays attack enemy crystals.
11).Mercenary (attack/blood: 2/15)
Skills: A group of 3 mercenaries, mocking, output, and a nurse.
12).Bone Dragon (attack/blood: 3/25)
Skills: Admission spikes enemies on the line.
13).Wizard(attack/blood: 2/20)
Skill: Absorb all BUFF states on the field.
14).One-Eyed Demon Lord(attack/blood: 3/45)
Skill: The range of damages that can be produced in a huge amount.
15).Goddess of War (attack/blood: 4/15)
Skills: Summon friendly forces to move quickly to your side.

2.BUG repair several

notes.title: [EA Update 05]《Lords of War》Ver:0.2.22.0 Interface performance optimization, Added The King's Head effect, and you can choose The national flag of your country！ (20171116)
notes.notes:
Hello my lords ， we will update a new version 

1. Added The King's Head effect
2. New features: choose The national flag of your country
3. New Features: Help and Support
4. New Features: Added collection of charts design progress display
5. Optimization:
      1).Player details interface to optimize player flash card and ordinary card collection progress display
      2).Level Details Check Level Card Details Increase left and right switching function
      3).Arena UI level is not correct
      4).Leaderboards display location optimization adjustments
      5).lucky pool get gold reward performance optimization
      6).Level video optimization (Display the latest clearance 3 video)
6. Interface Caton performance optimization
7. Level optimization: reduce the difficulty of some levels
8. Bug fixed:
      1).red dragon pups, blue dragon pups foot effects direction is not correct
      2).Grand Master skills display error
      3).Arena UI level is not correct
      4).Change to other units when playing cards
      5).Lucky Pool Bonus on the Arena after rewarded the interface is not refreshed
      6).Ladder leaderboards and battle card details of the title card effects disappear
9. Recharge money get double reward
10. Lucky pool add recharge double reward
11. Add comment feature Reviews the game can be rewarded

notes.title: [EA Update 03]《Lords of War》Ver:0.2.21.0 New card and Lucky pool is coming (20171030)
notes.notes:
Hello my lords ， we will update a new version 

1.New card: We added six neutral cards
     
1).Frost Magic Bird（ATK/HP:2/20）
           Skill:Each Pugong 2 times, will make the target frozen 2 seconds;Death Whisper: within 30 meters of the enemy was frozen for 3 seconds
     2).Dragon Egg（ATK/HP:0/10)
           Skill:Can not move;Death Whisper:random summon a young dragon (Whelp, Blue Whelp, Red Whelp),5 damage to all enemy units within 30 meters
     3).Archerfish（ATK/HP:1/8）
           Skill:Deceleration target, range deceleration;Far attack: attack distance increased by 60 meters
     4).Giant Mantis(ATK/HP:1/55)
           Skill:Each attack 3 times summon a larva mantis (1/1 Taunt);Death Whisper: 10 damage to all enemy units within 30 meters
     5).Night Killer（ATK/HP:2/20）
           Skill:Puncture attack;Blood teeth: Pugong 50% of the damage into their own blood;Death Whisper: Summon 3 bats
     6).
Supervision Wing（ATK/HP:1/15）
           Skill:Pu spoiled around 30 meters, sputtering damage for the attack power of 50%;Regulatory: every enemy on the field, get 1 point attack power
2.We released the IOS test version
3.Sign In replaced with Lucky poll
4.Output adjustment: We increase the daily task reward
5.Chat optimization: Add other people chat text translation function, optimize the chat refresh and send the mechanism
6.Interface optimization: optimization of the Android version of the interface card
7.BUG fixed:
     
1).Repair the Death Whisper inexplicable call out other units 
     2).Fixed the chat system channel message lost
     3).Fixed the chat interface to create a friendly match stuck
8.Card balance adjustment
     
1).Moon Priestess's life value from 30 down to 25   
     2).The cost of  Wisdom of Mason increased from 3 points to 4 points, but the cost of the two building cards was reduced by 1 point
     3).The target of Bomb Beast's Death Whisper from all the surrounding units to the surrounding enemy units, but the damage from 15 points down to 10 points
    
 4).Blue Whelp spell damage +3 down to +2
     5).Red Whelp spell damage +5 down to +2
     6).
Goldensun Flagellant attribute 2/25 modified to 1/35

[img]http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30148830/c37207cee95b26a31081563bc60c7abe9d4f6ebc.png[/img]

notes.title: The game may be delayed
notes.notes:
Sorry guys,
Because of we have not solved some of the problems, we did not  through the Valve review at the first time, we have been in accordance with the recommendations of Valve on the relevant issues were repaired, now we are waiting for Valve to re-audit, which may bring the game can not be release on time, once the audit passed, we will promptly release the game, hereby inform, thank you for your support!  ːsteammockingː
